title: Glowing avocado
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8ff5c' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b8ff5c' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='42' ry='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- shadow under avocado -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='22' ry='5' fill='#3a5a2a' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- avocado outer skin -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='27' ry='34' fill='#3f8f3a'/>
  <!-- lighter skin highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='48' rx='17' ry='24' fill='#5cb34e' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- inner flesh -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='19' ry='25' fill='#cde85a'/>
  <!-- flesh inner lighter area -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='59' rx='14' ry='19' fill='#e4f58e'/>
  <!-- pit -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='9' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- pit highlight -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='57' r='3.5' fill='#b57f45'/>
  <!-- pit shine -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#e3b878'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='47.5' y='20' width='5' height='8' rx='2.5' fill='#6a4a2a'/>
  <!-- stem light edge -->
  <rect x='48' y='20' width='2' height='8' rx='1' fill='#9a7048'/>
  <!-- cute eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='49' r='2.6' fill='#2d6b2d'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='49' r='2.6' fill='#2d6b2d'/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='42.2' cy='48.2' r='0.9' fill='#d9ffb0'/>
  <circle cx='56.2' cy='48.2' r='0.9' fill='#d9ffb0'/>
  <!-- cute smile -->
  <path d='M45 54 Q50 58 55 54' stroke='#2d6b2d' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='54' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#8fd46e' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='54' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#8fd46e' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- tiny sparkle right -->
  <path d='M74 38 L75.5 41 L78.5 41.5 L76 43.5 L76.8 46.5 L74 45 L71.2 46.5 L72 43.5 L69.5 41.5 L72.5 41 Z' fill='#e8ff9a' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- tiny sparkle left -->
  <path d='M24 30 L25.2 32.4 L27.8 32.8 L25.8 34.4 L26.4 37 L24 35.8 L21.6 37 L22.2 34.4 L20.2 32.8 L22.8 32.4 Z' fill='#f0ffb8' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
